questions.markdown: An AC voltage of 220V, 50Hz is applied to transformer having turns ratio 10:1. The secondary of transformer is connected to full wave bridge rectifier. The diode has cut-in voltage 0.6V and forward resistance 10$\Omega$. If the load resistance is 250$\Omega$, determine the average and rms values of output current and voltage. What should be the PIV rating of the diode?

A Si diode has reverse saturation current 20 nA at 25$^{\circ}$C.

a) Find the diode current when it is forward biased by 0.5 V.

b) Find the diode current when the temperature rises to 100$^{\circ}$C forward bias voltage of 0.5 V.
Explain the different types of breakdown mechanisms that can occur in a PN junction diode.

Determine the Output voltage, Zener current, and power dissipation of a Zener diode regulator circuit with a 16V input, 1k$\Omega$ series resistor, 10V Zener diode, and 3k $\Omega$ load resistor. Sketch the circuit.

Derive the drain current equation of a MOSFET in the triode region. Is it possible to determine the values of $\mu_n C_{ox}$ and $W/L$ by applying different values of $V_{GS} - V_{TH}$ and $V_{DS}$ and measuring $I_D$
Explain the I-V characteristics of a MOSFET and label the different regions of operation with appropriate conditions.
Draw the internal block diagram of the operational amplifier and explain the function of each block. Mention the ideal characteristics of OPAMP.

Design an adder circuit using two OP-AMPs to obtain

$$
V_{out} = 0.25V_1 + 1.5V_2 - 0.5V_3
$$

assume $R_f = 10k\Omega$
Perform the following using 2's complement method: Subtract $(64)_{10}$ from $(120)_{10}$
Obtain the simplified expressions for the outputs of a full-adder using K-map and implement the same using only NAND gates.
Represent the given Boolean expression in canonical SOP form and then implement the same using basic gates. $f = \overline{B}C + \overline{(A + B\overline{C})}$
Construct a 3-bit down-counter using suitable positive edge triggered flip-flops and draw the output waveforms showing all the possible states of the counter.

A message signal $10\cos(2000\pi t)$ amplitude modulates a carrier $40\cos(2\times 10^6\pi t)$. Find

a) modulation index

b) Sideband frequencies,

c) Bandwidth,

d) Amplitude of each side band,

e) Power in each sideband assuming $R = 50\Omega$.

In an FM system when the modulating frequency is 50 Hz and modulating voltage is 2.5 V, the deviation produced is 5 KHz. Calculate the modulation index. Now if the modulating voltage is increased to 7.5 V, calculate the new frequency deviation.
Binary data 10011 has to be transmitted using digital modulation techniques. Draw the digital signal, carrier signal and modulation signal in each of the modulation techniques ASK, FSK and PSK.
